class.name: RegionContainer
class.brief_description: A region-authoring node with optional bounds and a list of world decorators.
class.description: Containers form the world-definition child tree. Decorators are resources in [member decorators], not child nodes. A bounded container limits its operations and descendants to its translated local [member area]. An unbounded container adds no local enclosure. The root may be unbounded while [TerrainView] requests only a finite preview. This prototype supports translation only and rejects rotated/scaled containers. Child areas are explicitly authored; procedural child layout is not implemented.

members.member: Local axis-aligned enclosure, used when [member bounded] is true. Every dimension must be finite and positive. It does not create a new local ground plane; the flat base remains at world-space Y = 0.
When true, apply [member area] as a scope constraint. When false, no local bounds are imposed; a root then has an unbounded generation domain. Zero-sized bounds are not an unbounded sentinel.

Ordered resource attachments owned by this container configuration. Enabled attachments are applied once within their inherited scope. Equal priorities use scene-tree preorder, then this list order. Null entries are ignored.
